answer.label: A parody-account line — not verified Murray
answer.sourceLine: PolitiFact found the joke in a March 2014 post from an account explicitly disclaiming any affiliation with Murray. The investigation also shows how an unattributed internet repetition acquired apparent authority through a news slideshow. The account’s operator and the joke’s original creator remain unidentified.

context.heading: The setting behind the words
lead: The joke uses taking a portion of a child’s dessert as an analogy for taxation. PolitiFact’s investigation distinguishes an explicitly fake Murray account from the actor himself. Repetition in a news slideshow did not supply the missing original author. PolitiFact investigation ↗
